question: What attainment of divine companionship or status results from the preceding yogic practice?
premises: Divine maidens of the gods are involved.
The practitioner may become a yaksha or vidyadhara.
These are possible outcomes of the practice.
inference: The practitioner may gain the company of divine maidens and attain the status of a yaksha or vidyadhara.
uncertainties: deva-kanyā may be subject or object in compressed syntax; taken as attained companionship
plain_english: He may obtain divine maidens of the gods and become like a Yaksha or Vidyadhara.
